about: The prayer traces the offered gifts to God's own generosity. It joins two petitions: that the sacred mysteries sanctify us in our conduct in this present life and lead us to everlasting joys, through the working power of His grace.

seg.tr: Lord, we pray, accept the gifts we bring You from Your generosity, so that these most holy mysteries, through the working power of Your grace, may both sanctify us in the way we live this present life and lead us to everlasting joys. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: with the power of Thy grace at work
us in the conduct of this present life

ex.w023: The prayer concerns how we live, not a spoken conversation. It contrasts conduct in this present life with the everlasting joys for which we pray.
